# Retail CoD 1.5b dedicated server, a match timeout called and ended by one axis player.
# map mp_carentan, g_gametype tdm, g_timeoutsAllowed 2, g_timeoutLength 15000,
# g_timeoutRecovery 5000, g_timeoutBank 180000, dedicated 1, sv_maxclients 8, sv_pure 0,
# one client on the server. Captured 2026-10-14 with
# COD_VERSION=1.5 tools/run_server.sh mp_carentan +set g_gametype tdm +set g_timeoutsAllowed 2
# +set g_timeoutLength 15000 +set g_timeoutRecovery 5000 +set g_timeoutBank 180000 and
# vcod --net-probe --probe-team axis --probe-secs 34 --probe-say 6:matchtimeout
# --probe-say 7:matchtimeout --probe-say 8:matchtimein.
# !say is a client command at its second after the gamestate; !cmd every server command
# naming configstring 1628, 1629 or 227 (the cvar mirror's timescale value) or starting e,
# in arrival order, control bytes as \xNN; !frozen the serverTime the snapshots stood at and how many carried it.
!say 6.0 matchtimeout
!cmd d 1628 15000
!cmd d 1629 PATCH_1_5_TIMEOUT_CALLED\x14GAME_AXIS\x15
!cmd e "PATCH_1_5_TIMEOUT_CALLED_PLAYERNAME\x15vcod"
!cmd d 227 0
!say 7.0 matchtimeout
!cmd e "PATCH_1_5_TIMEOUT_ALREADYINPROGRESS"
!say 8.0 matchtimein
!cmd d 1628 5000
!cmd d 1629 PATCH_1_5_TIMEOUT_ENDING\x15
!cmd e "PATCH_1_5_TIMEIN_CALLED_PLAYERNAME\x15vcod"
!cmd d 1628 
!cmd d 227 1
!frozen 12150 142
